D.t: Daniel Biss leads by 56.1 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 145,199 votes; a one point swing is about 1,295 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +49.5 and D +62.1. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
